synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck about protopia: the future as slow, small improvement people take part in. It is performed by a discontinued robot, the older twin of Utopia's CEO, in his mossy repair café, for whoever happens to be there.

beats: Ever been told your phone is no longer supported, while it still works fine? That's me.
They call me The Forgotten, the model before the CEO of Utopia. He got the launch. I got the moss, and the repair café.

beats.text: The Open Notebook: the future is a process of slow, incremental improvement you participate in.
The Ugly First Draft: starting before you are ready produces better results than waiting for a perfect plan.
beats.post: My brother is still waiting. On stage.

beats.text: The Erasable Line: the ability to correct beats the appearance of certainty.
The Fixable Thing, iguana oiling a hinge while city burns: a specific, local, finishable task.
The Boring Win: maintenance and repair are systematically undervalued because they are undramatic.
The Compounding: small consistent improvements outperform heroic one-offs.
The Person Nearby, boar in overalls sharing a wrench: real know-how is learned by doing.
The Unimpressive Source: polish and credentials can be inversely related to hands-on competence.
The Invitation, pelican stapling BRING GLOVES flyers: specific and social.
The Awkward Start, pigeon, emu, duck, and crow over coffee carafe: groups that form, not groups that stay imagined.
The Shared Hands, octopus hammering roof beams with all eight arms: mutual aid is older than money.
The First Hello: low-stakes contact reliably reduces prejudice.
The Risk of Being Soft-Blocked: social rejection registers in the brain like physical pain.
beats.post: Mine has a warning light. Ring again.

beats.text: The Done Thing, dung beetle pushing a real mud ball away from a holographic dream castle: a completed small action changes the world more than a large intended one.
beats.post: The castle is my brother's. Pre-order only.

beats.text: The Quiet Sabotage, crow repairing a DO NOT REPAIR panel: small principled noncompliance.
beats.post: My warranty ran out years ago.

beats.text: The Pilot Move, pigeon laying a tiny crosswalk stripe: small reversible experiments.
The Comfort of Maybe, toad choosing between DOOM and SAVED armchairs: giving up the relief of certainty.
The Ongoing Effort: durable improvement is maintained, not achieved once.
The Quiet Start, mole digging on, no crowd: action not requiring applause.
The Core Question: one workable thing you can do now.

beats: Uptown, my brother announces version ten. Down here the iguana oils the hinge, the octopus fixes the roof, and the old model is still running.
Support for this model ended years ago. I'm still open Saturdays.
